QuestInfo.name: Much Needed Allies
QuestInfo.0: #bBitsie#k wants the #bSnow Child#k to come back to the village and live with everyone else. Edward has little faith in this dream, but he won't last for long living in the cold, rugged mountains alone. You decide to help the poor child, and discusses the next course of action with Bitsie.
